dict.string: NotchIsland reads what Music and Spotify are playing so it can show it in the island, and sends them play, pause and skip commands. From Spotlight it asks Finder to empty the Trash and macOS to show its Restart, Shut Down and Log Out dialogs. It asks Finder to move or delete a screen recording from its thumbnail's menu.
The equalizer beside the notch follows the music that is playing: bass on the left, treble on the right. The sound is only measured, never recorded or kept.
The Controls widget shows whether Bluetooth is on and switches it, like Control Center.
The Up Next widget and Spotlight show your coming events. They are read on this Mac only and never leave it.
Spotlight's People & Calendar finds your contacts by name so you can call, message or email them. They are read on this Mac only and never leave it.
NotchIsland saves screen recordings to the Desktop, as macOS does, and moves or deletes them from their thumbnail's menu.
NotchIsland moves a screen recording to Documents when you choose Save to Documents in its thumbnail's menu.
